items.t: A restored Zarosian artefact (will be lost)

recommended.t: Activated Al Kharid, Bandit Camp, and Menaphos lodestones
Desert amulet 4 provides teleports to Nardah and Uzer, but a Desert amulet 2 or amulet 3 only provides teleports to Nardah.
Sceptre of the gods / Pharaoh's sceptre / Master camouflage outfit (teleport option 9: Pyramid Plunder)
Ring of slaying / Pollnivneach tablet / Slayer cape to Pollnivneach / Pollnivneach Teleport (scroll from treasure trails)
Ring of charos (a) if using magic carpet ride
Antipoisons (or its variants) or other method of preventing poison damage such as the Venomblood perk

rewards.t: Slayer XP lamp (100000 Slayer XP; requires 87 Slayer)
Archaeology XP lamp (100000 Archaeology XP; requires 86 Archaeology)
Combat XP lamp (yields 75,000 experience in the selected combat skill (Attack, Strength, Defence, Constitution, Ranged, Magic, or Necromancy); requires level 75 in the selected skill)
Access to Scabaras' Temple of Isolation and the Elite Profane Scabarites within
A primed keris and the ability to upgrade it to a consecrated keris, rewarding 40000 Prayer XP when upgrading it. Talk to Scabaras again after the quest to receive it.

steps.t: Enter the Golden Palace in Menaphos. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Pharaoh Osman, Chosen of Tumeken. [Chat: Accept]
p: Meeting with Pharaoh Osman, Chosen of Tumeken in the throne room

steps.t: Go across the bridge east of the Menaphos lodestone into Sophanem and talk to the High Priest. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Beneath Scabaras' Sands'.]
Go to Pollnivneach and talk to Hakeem the Mayor. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Beneath Scabaras' Sands'.]
Go to Nardah and talk to Awusah the Mayor. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Beneath Scabaras' Sands'.]
Go to Al Kharid and talk to Emir Ali Mirza in the Al Kharid palace. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Beneath Scabaras' Sands'. › Any]
Enter the Golden Palace in Menaphos. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Kill the 4 Profane Scabarites and burst the 4 corrupted scarabs nearby.
Head down the steps near the Menaphos lodestone and kill the 4 Profane Scabarites and burst the 4 corrupted scarabs.

sub.t: The Profane Scabarites and corrupted scarabs from the previous step must be dealt with for the ones on the lower level to spawn.

steps.t: Head back up to the palace and talk to Commander Akhomet.
Enter the Golden Palace and talk to Pharaoh Osman, Chosen of Tumeken.

steps.sec: The hunt for the golden scarab
steps.t: Enter the Grand Library. [Chat: 1 Beneath Scabaras' Sands]

steps.sec: The hunt for the golden scarab
steps.t: Talk to Kohnen's assistant. You do not need to follow the assistant, and can just run ahead to Leela and Maisa who are in the south-western corner (down two levels, yellow dot on the minimap).

steps.sec: The hunt for the golden scarab
steps.t: Talk to Leela or Maisa.

steps.sec: The hunt for the golden scarab
steps.t: Search the nearby bookcases until you obtain The Shiny Scarab.

sub.t: The location can be different for each player.

steps.sec: The hunt for the golden scarab
steps.t: Talk to Leela or Maisa again.

steps.sec: The hunt for the golden scarab
steps.t: Enter the Uzer Mastaba. [Chat: 1 Head directly to the Pharaoh Queen.]

sub.t: You may use fairy ring DLQ.

steps.sec: The hunt for the golden scarab
steps.t: Talk to Senliten.

steps.sec: The hunt for the golden scarab
steps.t: Talk to Lead Archaeologist Kerner in the ruins of Uzer.

steps.sec: The hunt for the golden scarab
steps.t: Talk to Lead Archaeologist Kerner again. [Chat: 1 Yes]

steps.sec: The hunt for the golden scarab
steps.t: Gather scorched sand from any of the nearby locations. Continue screening the sand with the screening tray until you have 30 Kharidian gold and 2 ancient rubies.

steps.sec: The hunt for the golden scarab
steps.t: Restore the damaged golden scarab with the nearby archaeologist's workbench.

steps.sec: The hunt for the golden scarab
steps.t: Return and enter the Golden Palace [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Pharaoh Osman, Chosen of Tumeken.
p: Only follow going up first two stairs...the last set you need to make it go up the stairs as far as it will go on the right edge. Then back down the stairs once, push towards the middle....THEN back…

steps.t: Talk to Leela just outside the northern gates of Menaphos.
Release the golden scarab.
Follow the golden scarab at the locations indicated on the map on the right until you reach the Scabarite Cavern.

sub.t: Teleporting directly to the cavern will not work.
Don't miss the final golden scarab spot directly in front of the cavern. Doing so will cause you to have to repeat the entire path from Menaphos.

steps.t: Enter the cave entrance. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Head south and follow the golden scarab once more.

Scavenge the piles of debris in the cavern until you have five sets of boat materials. If a Profane Scabarite appears, it must be killed to obtain the materials. Teleporting out will result in loss of materials.
Repair the old boat.
Travel with the old boat.
Head east and up the steps and talk to Scabaras.

Go back down the steps and interact with Fear. You need to keep interacting with Fear to scare it up the steps to Scabaras. Guide it up the northern side of the steps as it is more likely to get stuck on the southern side.

sub.t: Only use the guide going up the first two stairs, after that, it is not accurate!

steps.t: Go through all options during the flashback. Scabaras will expect a specific response to each of his three statements, and the order is random for each player.

sub.t: "Mention of his children would have given him pause." [Chat: 3 Amascut and Icthlarin are not ready.]
"What if we had proposed an alternative?" [Chat: 1 There has to be another way.]
"What would Lady Elidinis have thought?" [Chat: 2 What insight has Lady Elidinis provided?]

steps.t: Following the cutscene, continue through the dialogue. [Chat: Any]
Interact with Ego at the bottom of the steps.

Pick from a cavern dwellberry bush near the old boat. Filling your backpack with several is helpful, but only one cavern dwellberry is needed if you're picking it back up just after dropping them in the next step.
Drop the cavern dwellberries to lure Ego up the steps.

sub.t: Ego can only be lured within five game squares.

steps.t: Go through all options during the second flashback.

sub.t: "Taking a firmer stance against her transgression may have dissuaded her." [Chat: 1 That is unacceptable!]
"What if we had challenged her perspective?" [Chat: 2 Your father sought to protect you.]
"What if we had placated her?" [Chat: 3 You are right.]

steps.t: Following the cutscene, continue through the dialogue.
Interact with Melancholy at the bottom of the steps and use the chat options to motivate the scarab to make it move up the steps repeatedly. Go through all chat options until it moves from each stop.
After the third flashback, head down the steps to find Grief.

sub.t: Grief appears as a red dot on the minimap.

steps.t: Keep stamping out Grief until it transforms into a level 146 monster.
Defeat the monster.
Talk to Scabaras. [Chat: 1 Ask about Amascut's plan. › 5 Continue Quest.]
Quest complete!
